CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION finance_apm_private.active(m finance_apm_private.metric_mappings)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from finance_apm_private.mapping_decisions d where d.mapping_id=m.id and d.decision='verified')
 and not exists(select 1 from finance_apm_private.mapping_decisions d where d.mapping_id=m.id and d.decision='revoked')
$function$

functions.name: actor
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION finance_apm_private.actor(entity text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare a jsonb;begin
 if not public.finance_auth_session_active() then raise exception 'FINANCE_APM_FORBIDDEN' using errcode='42501';end if;
 a:=private.finance_reporting_actor_v1(entity,'production');
 if public.current_finance_role() not in('accountant','ceo') or (a->>'canEditWorkpaper')::boolean is distinct from true then raise exception 'FINANCE_APM_FORBIDDEN' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return a;end $function$

functions.name: canonical
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION finance_apm_private.canonical(j jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v text;begin
 case jsonb_typeof(j)
 when 'object' then select '{'||coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(key)::text||':'||finance_apm_private.canonical(value),',' order by key collate "C"),'')||'}' into v from jsonb_each(j);
 when 'array' then select '['||coalesce(string_agg(finance_apm_private.canonical(value),',' order by n),'')||']' into v from jsonb_array_elements(j) with ordinality a(value,n);
 when 'number' then v:=trim_scale((j#>>'{}')::numeric)::text;
 else v:=j::text;end case;return v;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION finance_apm_private.correction_evidence(o finance_hr_private.finance_hr_obligations, reversal_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare id text;begin
 for id in select v.id from public.vouchers v where v.id=reversal_id or exists(select 1 from finance_hr_private.finance_hr_voucher_claims c where c.obligation_id=o.obligation_id and c.voucher_id=v.id)order by v.id loop
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('apm-voucher:'||id,847));
 end loop;return finance_apm_private.correction_evidence_before_lock(o,reversal_id);end $function$

functions.name: correction_evidence_before_lock
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION finance_apm_private.correction_evidence_before_lock(o finance_hr_private.finance_hr_obligations, reversal_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare original public.vouchers;reversal public.vouchers;before_rows jsonb;after_rows jsonb;ev jsonb;begin
 select v.* into original from finance_hr_private.finance_hr_voucher_claims c join public.vouchers v on v.id=c.voucher_id where c.obligation_id=o.obligation_id;
 select * into reversal from public.vouchers where id=reversal_id;
 if original.id is null or reversal.id is null or reversal.id=original.id or original.tenant_id<>o.tenant_id or reversal.tenant_id<>o.tenant_id
  or original.entity_id<>o.legal_entity_code or reversal.entity_id<>o.legal_entity_code or original.data_environment<>'production' or reversal.data_environment<>'production'
  or original.posted is distinct from true or reversal.posted is distinct from true or original.posted_at is null or reversal.posted_at is null
  or original.voided_at is not null or reversal.voided_at is not null or reversal.adjusts_voucher_no is distinct from original.no
  or original.total<>o.total_net_cents/100.0 or reversal.total<>original.total
  or not exists(select 1 from finance_hr_private.finance_hr_events where obligation_id=o.obligation_id and action='bank_disbursement' and actor_system='finance')
 then raise exception 'FINANCE_APM_REAL_SETTLEMENT_AND_REVERSAL_REQUIRED';end if;
 select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.account_code,t.department_code) into before_rows from (
  select account_code,coalesce(department_code,'') department_code,sum(debit) debit,sum(credit) credit from public.ledger_entries
  where tenant_id=o.tenant_id and entity_id=o.legal_entity_code and data_environment='production' and voided_at is null and voucher_no=original.no
  group by account_code,coalesce(department_code,'')) t;
 select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.account_code,t.department_code) into after_rows from (
  select account_code,coalesce(department_code,'') department_code,sum(credit) debit,sum(debit) credit from public.ledger_entries
  where tenant_id=o.tenant_id and entity_id=o.legal_entity_code and data_environment='production' and voided_at is null and voucher_no=reversal.no
  group by account_code,coalesce(department_code,'')) t;
 if before_rows is null or before_rows is distinct from after_rows then raise exception 'FINANCE_APM_REVERSAL_LEDGER_MISMATCH';end if;
 if (select sum((x->>'debit')::numeric) from jsonb_array_elements(before_rows) x)<>original.total
  or (select sum((x->>'credit')::numeric) from jsonb_array_elements(before_rows) x)<>original.total then raise exception 'FINANCE_APM_REVERSAL_LEDGER_MISMATCH';end if;
 ev:=jsonb_build_object('originalVoucherId',original.id,'reversalVoucherId',reversal.id,'originalVoucher',to_jsonb(original),'reversalVoucher',to_jsonb(reversal),'reversedLines',before_rows);
 return ev;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION finance_apm_private.guard_receipt_ledger()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare v record;begin
 for v in select x.id from public.vouchers x where(tg_op<>'INSERT'and x.tenant_id=old.tenant_id and x.entity_id=old.entity_id and x.data_environment=old.data_environment and x.no=old.voucher_no)or(tg_op<>'DELETE'and x.tenant_id=new.tenant_id and x.entity_id=new.entity_id and x.data_environment=new.data_environment and x.no=new.voucher_no)order by x.id loop
  perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('apm-voucher:'||v.id,847));
  if finance_apm_private.receipt_evidence_locked(v.id)then raise exception 'FINANCE_APM_RECEIPT_EVIDENCE_IMMUTABLE'using errcode='55000';end if;
 end loop;if tg_op='DELETE'then return old;end if;return new;end $function$

 if tg_op='DELETE'then return old;end if;return new;end $function$
